items.headline: Danny Boyle Confirms Use Of AI In New Movie 'Ink'
items.excerpt: "There's about 30 seconds of it in our movie," the Oscar winner said about using generative AI to bring the Kray twins and Margaret Thatcher to life on screen in old photographs.

items.headline: Google DeepMind, Amazon Web Services, Kling AI Join Busan Market Tech Program InnoAsia
items.excerpt: Busan's Asian Contents & Film Market unveiled its InnoAsia lineup, pairing global AI production-tech firms with seven Korean startups plus a branded-film contest.

items.headline: Avid Media Composer 2026.8 at IBC: Agentic Workflows, More
items.excerpt: At IBC, Avid shows the latest Media Composer with deeper Content Core integration and expanded agentic workflow intelligence, plus new collaboration and storage capabilities.

items.headline: Crafty Apes CEO Alana Newell
items.excerpt: From compositor to CEO: Alana Newell on where Crafty Apes is heading as VFX pipelines absorb new AI tooling and studios rethink how shots get made.

items.headline: This AI Workflow Flips Filmmaking on Its Head
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge walks through a workflow that uses existing footage to generate new camera coverage — reframing shots that were never actually captured that way on set.
